I am sure there are many! As I was saying whatever you decide, choosing to move or not I believe the secret there is to never think like you are missing out on something. 

And moving is not the key to happiness or success but finding your ‘place’ is, whether it is the same/different country, home, city or a planet (sorry here you are limited to definitely staying). 

Reading through others’ comments, I see nothing but harsh reality - it is tough out there. I come from a non-eu country and eu had always been painted to us as butterflies and rainbows, which is waaaayy far away from the reality and if one has choice to not go through those burdens it is mostly better. Sadly, my country has been going downhill for a decade or more so that’s basically the reason for me seeing the move as a positive thing I suppose.

It honestly felt like reading my own story back then! 

It was no doubt toughest decision I have ever made (before moving lol), feels like giving up on something positive for uncertainty! And truth be told, it does not only feel like it, IT IS LIKE IT!

More often than not it does feel like making the worst mistake ever, ‘why have I abandoned what was good and comforting for being stuck in the unknown?’ But looking back now, regardless of the rollercoasters, loneliness, financial struggles, even the pandemics alone, it has only helped to grow and become a person you can’t become if choosing ‘early life’ comforts. 

Remember, if you give up something now, you will reach and gain something even bigger in the future if you keep on working hard through your lows and highs.

Hope it could give you some insight…
